CleanerChat source attribution
==============================

The supplied CleanerChat 2.44 source is the reference for the integrated chat
presentation and message formatting in SurvivorsDragonUi.

Original metadata, preserved verbatim from CleanerChat.toc:

## Title: CleanerChat
## Version: 2.44
## Author: migwynkriid
## X-License: Custom

Original source repository pointer from GlassUI/Modules/Config.lua:

https://github.com/migwynkriid/CleanerChat-WotLK

Original attribution text, preserved verbatim from
GlassUI/Modules/Config.lua:

CleanerChat stands on the shoulders of two excellent addons. All credit for the original work belongs to their creators.

Glass
The immersive chat UI is built on Glass by mixxorz. This project keeps the spirit of Glass alive on 3.3.5.

ChatCleaner
The message filtering is based on ChatCleaner by Lars Norberg (Goldpaw). Backported to 3.3.5.

The supplied CleanerChat directory contains no standalone license text for
CleanerChat, Glass, or the Assets directory. Its "Custom" license metadata is
preserved above; this notice does not supply or infer additional license terms.

The bundled Ace, LibStub, LibSharedMedia, LibMoreEvents and LibEasing libraries
are not incorporated into this port.

The unchanged source coin atlas is retained as media/tex/tally/Coins.tga for
the current-gold HUD counter. Its original gold crop is the top-left 32x32
part of the 64x64 atlas. The integrated chat uses no image assets; its scroll
indicator remains text-only. The source and code attribution above remains
applicable.
